# Wei Ai · H53D

> A collection of utility tools built with SwiftUI & CoreML. Every app runs on device: no ads, no tracking, no file uploads.

Notes:

- The apps cover two areas: CAD and 3D (STEP, IGES, JT, DXF, STL and other mesh formats) and on-device AI tools for images and spreadsheets.
- Every app has a detail page, a privacy policy, and a support page on this site; the App Store links below are the official listings.
- These pages replace the older per-app sites on h53d.github.io, which now redirect here.

## Apps

- [STEP Reviewer](https://apps.h53d.xyz/apps/step-reviewer/detail.html): 100MB+ STEP · 1M+ Facets — Built for CAD review: STEP files in the hundreds of MB and faceted models above 1 million triangles, plus measurement, cross sections, PMI, and mesh export.
- [JT File Viewer](https://apps.h53d.xyz/apps/jt-file-viewer/detail.html): Open JT files offline on Apple devices — JT File Viewer is a native Apple app for opening and reviewing JT (.jt) files on macOS, iPhone, iPad, and Apple Vision Pro.
- [ForgeShape](https://apps.h53d.xyz/apps/forgeshape/detail.html): STL, STEP check and convert on device — ForgeShape opens STL, STEP, IGES, OBJ, GLB, and 3MF models on your device, finds what blocks printing — open edges, wrong normals, thin walls, overhangs — repairs it, and exports STL or 3MF for your slicer.
- [STEP File Viewer](https://apps.h53d.xyz/apps/step-file-viewer/detail.html): A lightweight, ad-free STEP viewer built for productivity — STEP File Viewer is a lightweight tool built for viewing .step and .stp files across macOS, iPad, and iPhone.
- [3D Model Viewer](https://apps.h53d.xyz/apps/3d-model-viewer/detail.html): Free to view, Easy to convert — 3D Model Viewer & Converter is a lightweight, user-friendly tool for managing 3D models.
- [DXF Assistant](https://apps.h53d.xyz/apps/dxf-assistant/detail.html): View DXF. Convert to PDF, SVG, PNG — DXF Assistant is a lightweight tool for viewing and editing DXF drawings and models, designed for macOS, iPad, and iPhone devices.
- [STL to STEP Assistant](https://apps.h53d.xyz/apps/stl-to-step-assistant/detail.html): Convert STL, GLB, and OBJ models to STEP offline and privately — STL to STEP Assistant is a focused local 3D model tool for converting mesh-based models into STEP files for CAD workflows.
- [NumisGallery](https://apps.h53d.xyz/apps/numisgallery/detail.html): The beauty of banknotes, beyond money — NumisGallery is a museum-style banknote viewer for people who enjoy currency design, visual culture, and history.
- [Shine3D](https://apps.h53d.xyz/apps/shine3d/detail.html): Free to view, Easy to share — More than a 3D viewer.
- [P2V Converter](https://apps.h53d.xyz/apps/p2v-converter/detail.html): Vector Magic — Convert your images into vector graphics effortlessly, easily transform pixel art into scalable vector graphics in just moments.
- [SheetCollector](https://apps.h53d.xyz/apps/sheetcollector/detail.html): Organize, edit, export spreadsheet — Easily import tables from various files and images.
- [pcAI Photo Retouch](https://apps.h53d.xyz/apps/pcai-photo-retouch/detail.html): Old photos clear, Styles appear — Want to make your old photos clear again? Want to turn photos into sketches, oil paintings, or even Van Gogh’s Starry Night style? AI can do it...
- [CutoutCraft](https://apps.h53d.xyz/apps/cutoutcraft/detail.html): Tap. Cut. Style. Export — AI CutoutCraft is a smart image editing tool powered entirely by on-device AI.
- [ShareGuard](https://apps.h53d.xyz/apps/shareguard/detail.html): Secure sharing made easy — ShareGuard protects sensitive information in your images — including hidden metadata as well as visible faces and text — giving you full control before sharing.
